market_portfolios.how_to_read: Values are FantasyCalc dynasty trade values (superflex, 12 teams, full PPR). move30 = 30-day market move of the players held now (trade-neutral). since_change = change since the snapshot dated `since` (includes trades). sidelined = value on IR/Out/PUP. Status flags: crash, correction, stable, bull.

trade_finder.how: Each suggestion comes from the Trade Finder logic: one side has a real need (the offered players would raise its starting lineup) or, for a rebuilder, the deal fits its timeline; the two sides are within 10% in FantasyCalc market value; each team is read as a contender, retooling or rebuilder. Build the issue's hypothetical trades from these (a and b are the two managers; as/bs are already in issue wording, keep them as written so the values and the Load in trade calculator link work). Write the desk commentary yourself; do not invent assets or values.

Darkspaces.tagline: Commissioner, negotiator, and the biggest margin of Week 7.
file: The type
A commissioner who competes, and a competitor who negotiates in public. Every roster move comes with an audience.
Signature move

Naming a price in the chat, then renegotiating it live. Swift for next year's 1st, Collins on the block, and Achane staying in the IR slot till next year. In Week 7 he claimed Quentin Johnston for $1 after Hades9mm cut him.
Nemesis
The margin, in both directions. A 0.56-point loss in Week 6, then a 78.46-point win in Week 7 that moved him no closer to a low pick.
The desk is watching
Hades9mm in Week 8, whether the block becomes a trade before the deadline, and a FAAB budget down to $103.
Darkspaces.headline: 3-4, 8th, the 1.03, and a 78.46-point win
story: The draft set the tone. Darkspaces cut the pick timer to a minute, loaded up on receivers, and handed nicknames to twenty-three of his own players, then spent the first waiver run buying a tight end he had not drafted for $101 and Singleton for $301 on top of it. That is $402 gone before the first Monday night.

The pattern since is spend big, sell high, talk loudly. Deebo Samuel went to Snipe58 for a 2027 2nd, Jake Ferguson went to Snipe58 for Colston Loveland, and Matthew Stafford went to the same buyer for two future 2nds and $100 of FAAB. Week 7 was the breakout: 144.34 to 65.88 over Sarge71, with Drake Maye at 28.44 as the QB of the week and the Seahawks the DEF of the week, and 23.9 still left on the bench.

He is 3-4, up three spots to 8th, with 883.14 points, 7th in the league. His MAXPF of 973.92 holds the 1.03, 79.02 points above Snipe58 at the 1.01. FAAB is $103 after a $1 claim on Quentin Johnston, who Hades9mm had just cut. In the chat he asked for a lower pick and said he has a WR1 and an RB1 on the market, which is where a commissioner's tank actually happens.
takes: The commissioner asked for a low pick and scored 144.34.
The block is open, the wallet is small, and the chat is the sales floor.

Snipe58.tagline: The quiet buyer who holds the 1.01 and left 42.3 on the bench.
file: The type
A win-now buyer who pays with the future. Stays out of the chat and lets the transaction log do the talking.
Signature move
Quietly converting picks into veterans. Deebo Samuel cost a 2027 2nd, Jake Ferguson cost Colston Loveland, and Matthew Stafford cost two future 2nds and $100 of FAAB.
Nemesis
The bench. 42.3 points stayed on it in Week 7, more than three times the 13.22 he lost by.
The desk is watching
Whether the 1.01 turns into a seller's market, fumbduckdumbfuck in Week 8, and the Justin Jefferson offers in the trade machine.
Snipe58.headline: 3-4, the 1.01, and 42.3 points on the bench
story: Snipe58 does not post much, but the ledger is loud. He bought Deebo Samuel for a 2027 2nd, traded Loveland for Ferguson, and paid a 2028 2nd, a 2029 2nd and $100 of FAAB for Stafford. Each deal was a present-tense purchase funded with future capital.

Week 7 was a 114.04 to 100.82 loss to C33DeezNutzz. Quinshon Judkins led at 23.4, and the bench scored 81.32, with 42.3 of it good enough to start. He fell one spot to 10th. His 752.56 points against are the fewest in the league, so the schedule is still kind.

The 894.9 MAXPF is the lowest in the league and makes him the 1.01 holder, with Sarge71 35.42 behind and Darkspaces 79.02. His 750.6 points are 11th in the league. Justin Jefferson, Brock Purdy and Stafford are the core, and FAAB is $400.
takes: Buys the present, sells the future, and sits on the first pick.
The lowest ceiling in the league and a bench that outscored the margin six times over.

StealingGas.tagline: Second place, the 1.08, and a perfect streak that ended at two.
file: The type
A self-declared tanker with a competitor's wallet. Announces the plan, then spends against it, and scores against it.
Signature move
The announcement-then-purchase combo: tank declared in Week 2, $99 on Stribling immediately, then $298 on Jaxson Dart. In Week 7 he made four free moves, three of them in under four minutes.
Nemesis
The draft rule, still. Two perfect lineups moved the 1.03 to the 1.05, and a 157.4 with 18.8 on the bench moved him to the 1.08.
The desk is watching
Whether he sells scorers before the deadline, C33DeezNutzz in Week 8, and $98 of FAAB. He told the chat his plan is to pop off now and go dormant for the playoffs.
StealingGas.headline: 4-3, 2nd, and the high score at 157.4
story: StealingGas opened the year with the league's worst score at 83.32, repeated it with 77.18 in Week 2, and announced the tank. Then he spent $99 on a waiver dart, followed it with $298 on Jaxson Dart, and posted a perfect 152.42 lineup in Week 3. Weeks 5 and 6 brought two more: 202.54, then 180.64, each with nothing left on the bench.

Week 7 was the Match of the Week and a 157.4 to 145.06 win over Hades9mm, the top score in the league. Geno Smith led at 24.48 and 18.8 stayed on the bench, which ended the perfect run. He is 4-3, up three spots to 2nd, with 987 points, 2nd in the league. His 1092.08 MAXPF moved him to the 1.08, and the market feed has four of his players on IR, Jaxson Dart among them.

The chat bits stay reliable. He pitched Dart to Johnny4Skins as the all-in play on injured quarterbacks, said it was another bye week for the Chiefs, offered the Mendoza and Tucker stack for '27, and called his team's plan to pop off and go dormant for the playoffs. Four free moves, Knight, Miller, Allen and Mumpfield, and FAAB stays at $98.
takes: The perfect lineups ended and the high score did not.
Announces a tank and wins the week.

Zygon.tagline: The IR Predictor. 6-1, and the highest MAXPF in the league.
file: The type
The algorithm manager. Builds the roster around production, then lets the numbers run.
Signature move
Listing handcuffs on the block as a dare. Emmett Johnson and Blake Corum are posted with the line make me regret it when Walker tears his ACL.
Nemesis
The bench. 30.1 stayed on the bench in Week 7, and Hades9mm held the top MAXPF until this week.
The desk is watching
Painty69 in Week 8, and whether the 1.12 and the highest ceiling hold.
Zygon.headline: 6-1, first place, and the top MAXPF, 1211.42
story: Zygon is the league leader at 6-1 and the only team that barely touches the waiver wire. His FAAB spend is $7: $2 on Ollie Gordon and $5 on Jacoby Brissett. The team is built on Jaxon Smith-Njigba, Kenneth Walker and Patrick Mahomes and has the league's highest points total at 1058.

Week 7 was a 148.38 to 114.4 win over CMac91 with Jaxon Smith-Njigba at 31.3 as the WR of the week and Trey McBride the TE of the week. 30.1 stayed on the bench out of 78.78. The Jets defense replaced Jacksonville for free. The only loss was Week 5 to C33DeezNutzz, after he asked the chat for food poisoning on Josh Allen.
He took the MAXPF lead, 1211.42 to Hades9mm's 1179.72, and with it the 1.12. FAAB is $493. The desk's view changed by one prediction: the formula has the ceiling now.
takes: Took the top MAXPF and still left 30.1 on the bench.
The formula does not bid, does not stop, and now has the ceiling.

Hades9mm.tagline: The sleeper puss, 4-3, and a ceiling that finished second.
file: The type
A balanced, hand-built roster and a buyer's budget. Every one of his 23 picks was his own, which is the rarest thing in this league.
Signature move

Selling a star for depth. The London deal moved Drake London for Quentin Johnston, Cam Ward, TreVeyon Henderson and a 2027 3rd. In Week 7 he cut Johnston for Jaylin Noel, and the commissioner claimed Johnston for $1.
Nemesis
StealingGas, who beat him by 12.34 in the Match of the Week, and Zygon, who took the highest MAXPF.
The desk is watching
Darkspaces in Week 8, after telling the chat he would out score him, and the 1.11.
Hades9mm.headline: 4-3, third place, and 99% of a perfect lineup in a loss
story: Hades9mm drafted every one of his 23 picks himself, and the roster shows it: Jayden Daniels and Jared Goff at quarterback, Amon-Ra St. Brown and London at receiver, Derrick Henry and Cam Skattebo at running back, Kittle and Kelce at tight end. He started 3-0, lost to Zygon in Week 4 and Painty69 in Week 5, and won in Week 6.

Week 7 was the Match of the Week and a 157.4 to 145.06 loss to StealingGas. Amon-Ra St. Brown led at 24.2, only 1.7 stayed on the bench, and the lineup was 99% of perfect. He is 4-3, still 3rd, with 977.56 points, 3rd in the league.

The feud with Darkspaces is still his best content: four 1sts for Mendoza, Maye, Achane and Egbuka, a threat to release the trade-talk logs, and in Week 7 an offer to take Darkspaces' players if he needs to tank. His 1179.72 MAXPF is second to Zygon and holds the 1.11. FAAB is $330.
takes: The second-best ceiling in the league and the most efficient lineup of the week.
99% of a perfect lineup, and still a loss.

Johnny4Skins.tagline: Dual-QB, dual-autopilot, and a second straight loss.
file: The type
The league's most hands-off roster. Johnny4Skins drafted a few good players, then left the room and let the system finish the job.
Signature move
Not spending. $500 of FAAB intact, and the only moves are free ones. In Week 7 he told the chat all three of his quarterbacks are out.
Nemesis
The quarterback room. All three are out, he told the chat, and the market feed has Jalen Hurts on IR.
The desk is watching
Whether the autopilot finds a quarterback against Sarge71 in Week 8, and the $500 of FAAB.
Johnny4Skins.headline: 4-3, 5th, and a second loss in a row
story: Johnny4Skins took Ja'Marr Chase and Lamar Jackson in the first two rounds, then went to dinner. The autopick drafted eighteen of his players, including Jalen Hurts, A.J. Brown, Tyler Warren, Kyren Williams, Brian Thomas and DK Metcalf. Not a single human opinion went into any of them.

It worked for four straight weeks after the Week 1 loss to Zygon, including a 163.56 to 140.36 win over Darkspaces in Week 5. Week 6 was a 127.72 to 106.06 loss to CMac91, and Week 7 was a 117.34 to 90.1 loss to YesChef23 with Kyren Williams at 18.1 and 8.6 left on the bench.

He is 4-3, down three spots to 5th, with 928.72 points, 5th in the league. His 1067.72 MAXPF holds the 1.06 and his $500 of FAAB is untouched. In the chat he said all three quarterbacks are out, and StealingGas offered him Jaxson Dart. Next is Sarge71.
takes: The robot has lost two in a row and the quarterback room is on the injury report.
A good autopick is not a plan when all three quarterbacks are out.

Sarge71.tagline: The engine without the cast, 1-6, and on crash watch.
file: The type
A top-end roster with nothing underneath. Star power at running back, and a bench that cannot cover a bye week.
Signature move
The quiet transaction. One move this season, cutting Jaxson Dart, watching StealingGas pay $298 for him, and taking Aaron Rodgers instead.
Nemesis
The injury report and the schedule. The market feed lists five players on IR or Out, 13.9% of his market value, and his 1074.94 points against are the most in the league.
The desk is watching
Whether the roster adds a real depth piece, Johnny4Skins in Week 8, and the 1.02.
Sarge71.headline: 1-6, last place, and the lowest score of the week
story: Sarge71 started 0-3, beat Painty69 by 1.34 in Week 4, then lost to Snipe58 in Week 5 and StealingGas in Week 6. Week 7 was a 144.34 to 65.88 loss to Darkspaces, the lowest score in the league and a margin of 78.46, with Bijan Robinson leading at 17.2 and 14.98 left on the bench.

The roster is Bijan Robinson and a supporting cast that scores on its own schedule. Tetairoa McMillan went for 45.2 in Week 4 and Robinson has two MVP weeks. He cut Jaxson Dart, watched StealingGas bid $298 on him, and replaced him with Aaron Rodgers. The market feed has him on crash watch, down 7.9% over 30 days.
At 1-6 he is 12th. His 930.32 MAXPF holds the 1.02, 35.42 points above Snipe58 for the 1.01. FAAB is untouched at $500, and the more useful move is still a trade, which Sarge71 has not made.
takes: Bijan is the engine and the engine is running alone.
The market feed and the scoreboard agree.

C33DeezNutzz.headline: 4-3, fourth place, and a bounce-back win
story: C33DeezNutzz opened with a 195.82, the highest score of Week 1, with Josh Allen providing 35.66, then lost to Hades9mm in Week 2, beat CMac91 in Week 3, lost to fumbduckdumbfuck in Week 4 and beat Zygon in Week 5, ending the unbeaten run.

Week 6 was a 111.52 to 95.46 loss to Painty69. Week 7 bounced back, 114.04 to 100.82 over Snipe58, with Zay Flowers leading at 27.7 and 9.6 left on the bench. He added quarterback Tanner McKee for free, dropping Ray Davis.

He is 4-3, still 4th in the standings and 4th in points at 946.14, and holds the 1.05 at 1046.24 MAXPF. FAAB is a full $500. In the chat Darkspaces told him he likes the trade the AI is suggesting and to hit him up for a WR, and Issue 7 had the two of them paired on Nico Collins.
takes: Bounced back by 13.22 and still did not spend a dollar.
The commissioner has a receiver for sale and a full wallet is listening.

Painty69.tagline: Elite top end, a bench that outscored the starters, and 63.08 left behind.
file: The type
A star at running back and almost nothing else. Made his last real pick in round 6 and let the CPU draft the remaining seventeen rounds.
Signature move
The silence. He promised to be positive and kind through the whole draft and has been quiet since Week 2.
Nemesis
The bench. 63.08 points stayed on it in Week 7, more than the 46.38 he lost by.
The desk is watching
Zygon in Week 8, and the 128.9 points on his bench.
Painty69.headline: 2-5, 11th, and a bench that scored 128.9
story: Painty69 took Jahmyr Gibbs at 1.01, then McCaffrey and Barkley back to back, and then stopped. The last real pick was in round 6, and the CPU made the remaining seventeen, tying him with Johnny4Skins at eighteen autopicks.

Weeks 5 and 6 were his first two wins, over Hades9mm 153.1 to 126.24 and C33DeezNutzz 111.52 to 95.46. Week 7 broke the streak: 147.68 to 101.3 against fumbduckdumbfuck, with Christian McCaffrey leading at 22.0. His bench scored 128.9, more than his starters, and 63.08 of it would have made the best lineup. Sleeper put him at 62% of perfect, the worst of the week, with Joe Burrow, Josh Jacobs and Mason Taylor the best benchwarmers at QB, RB and TE.
He is 2-5, down one spot to 11th, with 863.06 points. His 1130.94 MAXPF is third in the league and the 1.10 is his. He did not say a word in the Week 7 chat either, which fits.
takes: The bench scored more than the starters.
Third-best ceiling in the league and the worst lineup of the week.

CMac91.tagline: The depth collector, 3-4, and a streak-ender that did not repeat.
file: The type
The league's most patient manager. Builds depth, stays out of drama, and has not spent a dollar of FAAB.
Signature move
Adding depth at no cost. Jaydon Blue, Travis Hunter and Kimani Vidal arrived without a bid.
Nemesis
The bench. 25.64 stayed on it in Week 7, and 47.98 in Week 5, more than the 47.46 he lost by.
The desk is watching
YesChef23 in Week 8, and whether depth ever turns into a lineup.
CMac91.headline: 3-4, down three spots, and 25.64 on the bench
story: CMac91 asked in round 5 whether there were seriously 23 rounds, played through round 11, and let the robot finish the draft, which gave him twelve autopicks. The first-round pick was James Cook, followed by CeeDee Lamb at 2.02 and Bo Nix at 3.02.

Week 4 brought 183.42, the high score of the week, and Week 5 brought 74.52, the lowest. Week 6 was a 127.72 to 106.06 win over Johnny4Skins that ended his four-game streak. Week 7 gave it back: a 148.38 to 114.4 loss to Zygon, with Bo Nix leading at 26.18 and 25.64 left on the bench.

At 3-4 he fell three spots to 9th, with 881.62 points, 8th in the league. FAAB is a full $500 and the 1.07 is his at 1070.9 MAXPF. The desk's view is the same as before: the roster is fine and the lineup is the variable.
takes: Depth first, spending never, and a 25.64-point bench.
One win ended a streak and the next week gave it back.

YesChef23.tagline: The restaurant arc. Two wins in a row and still the 1.04.
file: The type
A chef who wins while complaining. Chatty in the draft room, aggressive on waivers, and 3-3 with a bull market.
Signature move
Cheap waiver insurance. $1 on Deshaun Watson when Caleb Williams went down, $1 on J.J. McCarthy the week after, and in Week 6 $35 on Michael Mayer.
Nemesis
StealingGas, who beat him by 114.4 in Week 5, and Painty69, who he has needled since the draft room.
The desk is watching
CMac91 in Week 8, the Tyler Shough offers in the trade machine, and the 1.04.
YesChef23.headline: 4-3, 7th, and two wins in a row
story: YesChef23 opened the draft fighting an Uber Eats driver who stole a customer's order, took shots at the turtle ass drafters, and threatened to take defenses the rest of the way before settling for two. He beat fumbduckdumbfuck in Week 1, lost to Zygon by 92.86 in Week 2, beat Painty69 in Week 3 by 4.68, and lost to StealingGas in Week 5.

Week 6 was a 141.56 to 141.0 win over Darkspaces with Tyler Shough at 26.96 and the Chiefs defense the DEF of the week. He also added Michael Mayer for $35, dropping Roman Wilson, and Tyler Higbee for free, dropping Joe Mixon. Week 7 was a 117.34 to 90.1 win over Johnny4Skins with Luther Burden III at 23.7 and 17.6 left on the bench.
He is 4-3, up one spot to 7th. FAAB is $449 and his 991.7 MAXPF holds the 1.04. His 803.22 points are the third-lowest in the league.
takes: Two wins in a row and the points total is still third-lowest.
The restaurant is open, and the kitchen is quiet.

fumbduckdumbfuck.tagline: The Issue 1 No. 1, back at 4-3 and 6th.
file: The type
The desk's preseason favorite, and a roster that is better than the record. Seventh in the standings and eighth in points.
Signature move
Quietly good at running back. Jeanty, Taylor and Bowers form a core that scores every week.
Nemesis
YesChef23, who ended the Issue 1 No. 1 label in Week 1, and Zygon, who beat him by 32.08 in Week 6.
The desk is watching
Snipe58 in Week 8, and the 24 left on the bench.
fumbduckdumbfuck.headline: 4-3, 6th, and a 46.38-point bounce-back
story: fumbduckdumbfuck was the desk's number one in Issue 1, and the roster still supports it: Brock Bowers at 1.12, Ashton Jeanty at 2.01, Jonathan Taylor at 3.01, with Rashee Rice, DeVonta Smith and Dak Prescott behind them.

Week 6 was a 122.8 to 90.72 loss to Zygon with 43.4 left on the bench. Week 7 fixed it: 147.68 to 101.3 over Painty69, with Tony Pollard at 36.5 as the RB of the week and 24 still left on the bench. The earlier losses were close: 113.10 to 127.06 against YesChef23 in Week 1 and 127.74 to 139.80 against Hades9mm in Week 3.

He rose one spot to 6th at 4-3, with 891.26 points, 6th in the league. His 1101.28 MAXPF holds the 1.09, FAAB is a full $500, and the market feed has the roster on correction, down 3.2% over 30 days. The quarterback room is still the open question, and Kyler Murray arrived free in Week 4.
takes: The roster was always better than the record, and the record is catching up.
The bench problem got smaller and the score got bigger.

He is 2nd at 4-3 with 987 points, second in the league, and his 1092.08 MAXPF puts him at the 1.08. The poll gave him two votes.
drama_sample.desk: The perfect lineups were costing him draft slots, and the imperfect one still cost three. The draft rule has not lost yet.
